summary: FASE 3.2 (Azuris logo integration + premium A6 certificate PDF redesign) — ALL BACKEND + FRONTEND TESTS PASS. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_1_pdf_visual.py: 11/11 PASS in 7.05s. Read-only regressions verified (POST /api/verify with fake AZR-GEM-2026-999999 => generic 'not_found' with no leakage; GET /api/verify/qr/resolve with invalid token => token_valid=false; GET /api/settings/public => whatsapp_number='6287812128884' + whatsapp_enabled=true; GET /api/legality => unpublished/empty). PDF E2E: created 1 TEST_ Blue Sapphire (Corundum) gemstone → issued cert (AZR-GEM-2026-000015) → GET /api/admin/certificates/{uuid}/pdf returned HTTP 200 application/pdf, exactly 2 pages, each mediabox 419.53 x 297.64 pt (148 x 105 mm A6-landscape, ±1pt). Rendered page 2 with pdf2image@300dpi and decoded QR with pyzbar — payload matched '<base>/?qr=<token>#verification' and embedded token equalled the qr_token returned at issuance. Public /api/verify with (cert_number, security_code) and /api/verify/qr with token both returned 'valid' with full details; confirmed security_code AND qr_token are NEVER present in either public verification response body. MANDATORY CLEANUP + COUNTER RESTORE succeeded: certificate + gemstone + verification_token deleted, no photo uploaded, counters.certificate:{year=2026}.last_number restored to 14. Final DB state asserted and independently re-verified via a second mongo query: certificates==0, gemstones==0, counter.last_number==14 → next real certificate WILL be AZR-GEM-2026-000015. FRONTEND (Playwright): the Azuris logo image /azuris-logo.png returns HTTP 200; all five branded test-ids render and are visible in DOM: header 'azuris-logo' (home), 'hero-logo' (home slide 1), 'footer-logo' (home), 'legality-logo' (/legalitas hero), 'login-logo' (/login), and 'admin-logo' (admin sidebar after logging in with admin@azuris.local). Admin login redirect goes to /admin/legalitas as expected. Zero JS/pageerror/console-error entries across the 5 pages tested. Layouts intact (screenshots captured).
critical_code_review_comments: HOT-RELOAD GLITCH (env, not a code bug): First Playwright pass reported hero-logo/legality-logo missing (count=0 in DOM) even though source files at src/pages/public/HomePage.tsx L134 and LegalityPage.tsx L63 contain the tags. Verified by grepping the served bundle.js: it contained footer-logo/login-logo/admin-logo/azuris-logo but NOT hero-logo/legality-logo. `touch`-triggered incremental recompiles did not incorporate those additions; only a full `supervisorctl restart frontend` produced a bundle containing all five test-ids and subsequent DOM checks passed. Root cause is CRA/webpack incremental watch dropping edits when files change while the dev server is quickly re-serving — not a functional regression in the app. Recommendation: main agent shouldn't ship any code fix for this; but note the pattern for future FASE testers (do a hard frontend restart after wide edits touching many source files before Playwright validation).

services/certificate_pdf.py — the redesigned A6 booklet still respects PAGE_W=148mm × PAGE_H=105mm and produces exactly two pages, and QR still binds to cert['qr_url'] = '<PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/?qr=<token>#verification'. Contract preserved from FASE 3.1. No changes required.

Same non-blocking notes from iteration_7 still apply: (a) api/certificates.py PDF endpoint silently swallows SettingsRepository failures — consider logging at warning; (b) services/issuance.py qr_url() falls back to a preview host when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset (currently the case in backend/.env); consider requiring PUBLIC_BASE_URL in production; (c) build_certificate_pdf embeds Times/Helvetica because brand TTFs aren't bundled — wire pdfmetrics.registerFont if/when brand fonts land.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 branded logos visible, HTTP 200 asset, 0 JS errors, admin redirect ok)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ gemstone + 1 certificate (AZR-GEM-2026-000015) purely for the PDF E2E, then FULLY REMOVED. Counter restored: counters.certificate:{year=2026}.last_number = 14 (verified twice). Next real number will be AZR-GEM-2026-000015. DB is go-live-clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_1_pdf_visual.py (11 tests, ~7s) still applies; run with '-o addopts=' to avoid xdist LoadScope racing cleanup vs PDF-E2E (documented in module docstring). Deps present: pypdf, pdf2image, pyzbar, libzbar0, poppler-utils. PUBLIC_BASE_URL still unset so QR points to the current preview host — expected. IMPORTANT for frontend testers: if you edit many .tsx pages in one shot, do `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` before Playwright checks — incremental hot-reload occasionally omits new data-testid attributes from bundle.js and yields false-negative missing-element failures (I hit this exact case here for hero-logo/legality-logo; grep the served /static/js/bundle.js for the test-id string to confirm whether it's a bundle miss vs a code miss).
rca of the issue: No production RCA. One transient testing artefact: first Playwright pass reported hero-logo/legality-logo missing from DOM. Grep of served /static/js/bundle.js showed the strings were absent from the bundle even though the source .tsx files contained them. Incremental webpack recompile did not fix it. Full `supervisorctl restart frontend` produced a bundle containing all five test-ids, and Playwright then confirmed all logos render and are visible. This is a CRA/webpack dev-server incremental watch quirk on this environment, not an app defect.
